newsitem.title: UK: Laporte sees 19 mln gain from disposals.
newsitem.headline: Laporte sees 19 mln gain from disposals.

text.p: British speciality chemical products group Laporte Plc said on Wednesday it would make an exceptional gain before expenses and tax of 19 million stg on the sale of its adhesives and sealants businesses.
Laporte said the sale, announced in May, had reaped gross proceeds of 96 million stg, some six million stg more than initially announced.
"The fundamental re-focusing of the Laporte portfolio into a higher growth, global business has now been very largely completed," chief executive Jim Leng said in a statement.
Leng said Laporte's disposals programme had raised more than 250 million stg.
